notes:
- Project Xfer: new Send to Google Drive button. Sends as usual (a copy stays in the project's io/xfer folder), then copies the package to your Google Drive folder. Greyed out when Google Drive isn't connected.
- You pick your Google Drive folder the first time; change it any time from the line under the Send buttons
- Project Xfer Receive: new Google Drive... button lists the packages in your Google Drive folder, newest first
- Works whatever drive letter Google Drive is on
- Also new in 3.23.0: Project Utilities > Connect to Google Drive walks you through setting up Google Drive as G: on your home computer
